text: Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, so employees can focus on more interesting work. Productivity tools powered by AI help people organise their time, write emails faster, and analyse data quickly. Human-AI collaboration is also becoming common, as workers use smart systems to support their decisions instead of replacing them. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones will appear, and many workers will need training to learn new skills. Overall, AI can make work more efficient, but people must adapt to the changes it brings.
